cc:Work.dc:title: Ablation: task success at 2K and 4K
cc:Work.dc:description: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Error bars: reported sample-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. Matched 2K/4K outcomes are identical; do not pool as independent tasks. A zero-width empirical CI does not imply zero population uncertainty. Sources: docs/results/ablation_2k_h100_20261111/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-2026-11-11.md; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md
